tasks.subject: Task 2: JitterStats.perSpeaker + engine snapshot
tasks.description:
**Goal:** JitterStats carries a per-speaker breakout; AudioVoiceEngine publishes it ~every 500ms, aggregate derived.

**Files:** Modify voice/JitterStats.kt, voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt (_jitter update ~372-375 + playbackLoop counter); Test voice/JitterStatsTest.kt (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:** SpeakerJitter is a data class; JitterStats(perSpeaker) derives max aggregate (empty=10/0); engine snapshots perSpeaker every ~25 ticks via NEW counter jitterSnapshotTick (not diagTick); AudioDiagnosticsScreen still reads targetMs/p95Ms.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*.JitterStatsTest" then full suite.

Full code: plan Task 2.

tasks.subject: Task 3: MumbleModel per-user ping + carry-forward
tasks.description:
**Goal:** MumbleUser carries nullable ping; UserStats reducer writes it; applyUserState preserves it (fable-caught blocker).

**Files:** Modify model/MumbleModel.kt; Test MumbleModelTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:** MumbleUser has nullable tcp/udpPingMs; applyUserStats writes ping (guarded), unknown session no-op; applyUserState carries ping forward; onUserStats delegates.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*.MumbleModelTest"

Full code: plan Task 3.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/model/MumbleModel.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/MumbleModelTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*.MumbleModelTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["MumbleUser has nullable tcp/udpPingMs", "applyUserStats writes ping, unknown session no-op", "applyUserState carries ping forward", "onUserStats delegates"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: MumbleManager gated UserStats polling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** While enabled, the active session polls UserStats for each known user ~every 5s; disabled/idle sends nothing.

**Files:** Modify MumbleManager.kt (manager forwarder near setMuted ~115, ActiveSession poll loop, USERSTATS_POLL_MS const)

**Acceptance Criteria:** setUserStatsPolling(true) polls each user every ~5s on sessionScope; setUserStatsPolling(false) cancels, no-op with no active session; full suite green.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest

Full code: plan Task 5.


tasks.subject: Task 6: PerUserStatsScreen + nav + polling gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Dedicated debug screen: server RTT once + per-user row (name/ping/target/p95/buffered/lateDrops), reached from Audio diagnostics, polling only while open.

**Files:** Create ui/PerUserStatsScreen.kt; Modify ui/AudioDiagnosticsScreen.kt (onOpenPerUser param + clickable row), ui/DumbleApp.kt (nav boolean, branch before showDiagnostics, DisposableEffect)

**Acceptance Criteria:** screen shows server RTT + per-user rows joined by session (— when no active stream), empty state; entry row opens/back returns; DisposableEffect toggles setUserStatsPolling; assembleDebug succeeds.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
